title: Pwm
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Pwm
learningObjectives: Define duty cycle as the fraction of each PWM period during which the signal is held high
Predict how moving the duty cycle slider from 0% to 100% widens the high pulses while the waveform period stays fixed
Explain how a microcontroller uses PWM duty cycle to control motor speed or LED brightness without changing the supply voltage
Calculate the average output voltage of a PWM signal as the duty cycle times the high-level voltage
Distinguish duty cycle from frequency by observing which property of the square wave the slider actually changes
